newsitem.title: USA: Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac pass risk inspection.
newsitem.headline: Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac pass risk inspection.

text.p: The Office of Federal Housing Enterprise Oversight (OFHEO) gave passing grades to both Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac after examinations for business risk.
OFHEO concluded that management of risk relating to the single-family mortgage business for both institutions was "generally strong."
Certain aspects of risk management could be improved at both companies in the normal course of business, OFHEO said in a statement Tuesday.
A data integrity examination was conducted at Freddie Mac because of ongoing difficulties with accuracy, completeness and consistency of Freddie Mac's data supplied to OFHEO.

While internal controls over data integrity for financial mortgage data at Freddie Mac were effective, "systems controls over derivatives, debt, and securities transactions systems are not adquate to ensure data integrity," OFHEO said.
"However, compensating management controls are adequate for financial reporting and internal uses of data."
OFHEO said Freddie Mac had agreed to implement all its recommendations to improve the situation.
